notes: Critical install bug fixes for 0.4.0/0.4.1. THREE bugs: (1) scripts/sprint/ and scripts/dispatch/ missing from manifest scan; product repos got /sprint:* commands but not the engine scripts. (2) install.ps1 wrote framework-installed.json with UTF-8 BOM via PowerShell 5.1; /warp:update silently broke. (3) install.ps1 never copied .claude/framework-manifest.json itself; product's manifest stayed stale forever. All three fixed. All product repos MUST re-bootstrap via install.ps1 once.
